name: Foods
overview: Scripture reveals that God originally provided humanity with plants and fruits as food, emphasizing a diet from the earth's herbs and seed-bearing trees (Genesis 1:29-30). This provision extended not only to humans but also to animals, highlighting God's sovereign care over all living creatures. Additionally, the value of food is not measured by abundance but by the presence of love, as illustrated in Proverbs 15:17, which contrasts a simple meal enjoyed in love with a lavish feast accompanied by strife.
